big_picture.title: Stock Market Wages Huge Reversal On Nvidia CEO Comeback; Find These Hints For The Rally To Last
big_picture.excerpt: Are there truly a lot of great stocks to buy now?
paragraphs: The stock market on Monday reminded investors not to forget this aphorism: Expect the unexpected.

Just days after the executive board of Nvidia (NVDA), the world's largest company by market value, unanimously ruled out any consideration of Jensen Huang returning as CEO, it did a 180-degree pivot. Urged by a proactive White House to consider the fate of America's race for artificial intelligence supremacy, the board said it reinstated the co-founder and longtime leader of the AI chip systems innovator.
